run_supervised_cl_mnist: run the supervised continual learning benchmark experiment on the MNIST dataset
run_supervised_cl_omniglot: run the supervised continual learning benchmark experiment on the Omniglot dataset
run_training_with_custom_encoder: run training with a multi-layer encoder using configurable hidden unit sizes and strides
run_training_with_custom_decoder: run training with a single-layer decoder using configurable hidden unit sizes
run_training_with_replay: run training with configurable generative replay type and supervised replay options
